system.description: Whenever you make a single attack with a Lightsaber as a Standard Action, you can immediately make an attack with a Pistol as a Free Action, provided you have both weapons in hand when you make the Lightsaber attack. The normal penalties for using two weapons apply to both attacks.

prerequisite.text: Dual Weapon Mastery I feat, Weapon Proficiency (Lightsabers), Weapon Proficiency (Pistols), and Base Attack Bonus 5

nodes.text: Dual Weapon Mastery I feat, Weapon Proficiency (Lightsabers), Weapon Proficiency (Pistols), and Base Attack Bonus 5
